latest_autonomous_wave.title: Bounded Resumable Cache Retention and Delete Tombstones
latest_autonomous_wave.goal: Bound A41 crash-resume retry storage and ensure Lane-1 local deletion can never be confirmed while committed, staging, or resumable stem bytes remain or can be resurrected by a late same-job retry.
latest_autonomous_wave.rationale: A41 deliberately retains validator-bound partial stem bytes after interruption, but those caches had no TTL/count/total-byte lifecycle. A43 inspection also found that PrivacyRetentionService previously deleted only artifact_root/<jobID>, while output collection can own <jobID>.staging and <jobID>.download-cache; local deletion could therefore be recorded confirmed while Lane-1 user content survived.
latest_autonomous_wave.done_when: Inactive resume caches are bounded by TTL/count/bytes; active output collection is protected by an external per-job lease; privacy deletion durably tombstones the job and removes committed/staging/cache surfaces before local confirmation; deleted jobs are rejected before source hashing/cost/provider work and before output collection; regressions/evidence/status are durable without claiming P021/P024 parity.
latest_autonomous_wave.result: Added ResumableTransferCacheManager with bounded reclamation, external POSIX job leases, durable delete tombstones and maintenance-vs-privacy purge semantics; added the bounded A43 wrapper and wired BudgetedProductionSeparationOrchestrator to reject deleted jobs before source IO/cost reservation. PrivacyRetentionService now tombstones/purges resume cache, removes committed and .staging directories, verifies absence plus tombstone, then permits local_delete_confirmed. Added 24 formal repository tests across cache lifecycle, privacy deletion, deleted-job runtime, budgeted delete-first ordering and dependency binding. Exact repository-native A43 discovery remains NOT_OBSERVED; an interface-compatible focused harness passed 9/9 assertions.
